Ivy (AE): Passing Trifecta (TF-2245) to CS. Quick summary:
- 25 seats now, plan to 50 in Q4
- Private VPC, target dedicated pool May 1
- Contact: anya@trifecta.com (Anya, infra lead)
- Renewal: 2026-10-15
- Pilot ok, outstanding: SSO metadata + IP allowlist
- Risks: If peering/SSO delayed >2w they may postpone go-live
Links: contract https://redwood.app/contract/TF-2245

Ravi (CS): Ill own onboarding. Asking: who provides ACS/EntityID and when can we get IP ranges?

Ivy (AE): Anya will provide ACS after we confirm URLs. No IPs yet; expect 1-2 week infra approval window.

Eve (Enablement): Can run a 90m run-through for their SREs week of Apr 7. Need attendee roles.

Lina (Eng): Please open infra ticket for VPC peering + static egress. Need expected qps and sample prompt set to size pool. Deadline Apr 10 for May 1 target.

Ravi (CS): Added to tracker: https://redwood.app/onboard/TF-2245. Owners: Ravi (CS), Lina (Eng), Eve (Enablement), Ivy (AE). Milestones: IdP config (wk1), Peering (wk2), Canaries (wk3), Go-live May 1.

Ivy (AE): Mitigation note: offer hosted sandbox to avoid blocking customer testing while peering completes.

Lina (Eng): Also request: small eval prompts + traffic profile. @Ravi please add 10 prompts to tracker.

Handoff Bot: Workspace created: https://redwood.app/workspace/TF-2245-onboard :white_check_mark:

Ravi (CS): Will add prompts + OKRs: "<90ms median", "no P0 infra in 30d", "SSO in prod by go-live". Following up with Anya for ACS and IP ranges.
